rows.text: We are updating our full year 2026 guidance and now expect organic net sales growth (2) in the range of 6.5% to 7.0% and adjusted net earnings per diluted share (2) to be in the range of $14.80 to $14.90.
We are narrowing our full year 2026 guidance and now expect organic net sales growth (2) in the range of 8.3% to 9.3% and adjusted net earnings per diluted share (2) in the range of $14.95 to $15.10.
